name: Armageddon
overview: Armageddon is presented in Scripture as a symbolical name for the final gathering place of the nations for God's decisive judgment. The book of Revelation describes demonic spirits working to gather earthly kings for a great battle on this day of God Almighty, specifically naming the location Armageddon (Revelation 16:14-16). This aligns with Joel's prophecy of God assembling the nations in the valley of Jehoshaphat to plead with them for His scattered people Israel and to execute judgment (Joel 3:2, 12). Ultimately, Armageddon signifies the climactic confrontation between God's sovereign justice and the forces of evil, including Satan and his angels, who have been cast out to deceive the world (Revelation 12:9).
